customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, with an elegant design and excellent taste. The installation process is quick and perfect. However, reliability and value for money receive mixed feedback - while some say it works perfectly and is good for its price, others report it stops working after 7 months and consider it not worth the cost.
